name: Jimeta Plastic Buy-Back Hub
address: Off Atiku Abubakar Road, Jimeta, Yola North
notes: Pays per kg for clean, dry PET bottles and nylon sachets. Rinse before drop-off.

name: Adamawa E-Waste Collection Point
address: Adamawa State Environmental Protection Agency yard, Yola South
notes: Accepts phones, laptops, cables, dry-cell and lead-acid batteries. Never burn e-waste.

name: Yola Central Scrap Metal Yard
address: Near Yola Main Market, Yola South
notes: Weighbridge on site. Aluminium cans and roofing sheets fetch the best rates.

name: Karewa Glass & Bottle Depot
notes: Whole bottles are reused; broken glass accepted in sealed boxes only.

name: MAUTECH Community Compost Site
address: Modibbo Adama University perimeter, Girei Road
notes: Free drop-off for kitchen and farm waste. Finished compost sold to local farmers.

name: Doubeli Paper & Carton Recyclers
notes: Flatten cartons. Wet or oily paper is rejected.

name: Yolde Pate Textile Reuse Point
notes: Wearable clothing is redistributed; worn fabric becomes industrial rags.

name: Specialist Hazardous Waste Intake
address: Federal Medical Centre service gate, Yola
notes: Sharps, expired medicine, paints and solvents. Must be sealed and labelled.
